==English== {{wp|}} ===Alternative forms=== * {{alt|en|propretie}} ===Etymology=== From {{inh|en|enm|propertee}}, {{m|enm|properte}}, {{m|enm|propirte}}, {{m|enm|proprete}}, borrowed from {{der|en|xno|-}} and {{der|en|fro|propreté}}, {{m|fro|proprieté||propriety, fitness, property}}, from {{der|en|la|proprietās||a peculiarity, one's peculiar nature or quality, right or fact of possession, property}}, from {{m|la|proprius||special, particular, one's own}}. Equivalent to {{suffix|en|proper|ty}}. {{doublet|en|propriety}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/ˈpɹɒp.ə.ti/|a=Received Pronunciation}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈpɹɑ.pɚ.ti/|[ˈpɹɑ.pɚ.ɾi]|a=General American,dialects of Canada}}, {{enPR|prŏʹpərdē}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-property.ogg|a=US}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈpɹɒp.ɚ.ti/|[ˈpɹɒp.ɚ.ɾi]|a=Canada,dialects of the US}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈpɹɔp.ə.ti/|[ˈpɹɔp.ə.ɾi]|a=Australia}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈpɹɒp.ə.ti/|[ˈpɹɔ̟p.ə.ɾi]|a=New Zealand}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈpɾɔpəɾte/|/-tɪ/|/-ti/|a=Scotland}} * {{hyph|en|pro|per|ty}} ===Noun=== {{en-noun|~}} # Something that is [[own]]ed. #: {{ux|en|Leave those books alone! They are my '''property'''.}} #: {{ux|en|Important types of '''property''' include real '''property''' (land), personal '''property''' (other physical possessions), and intellectual '''property''' (rights over artistic creations, inventions, etc.).}} #* {{quote-book|en|year=1927|author=[http://openlibrary.org/authors/OL2416183A F. E. Penny] |chapter=4|title=[http://openlibrary.org/works/OL16814587W Pulling the Strings] |passage=A turban and loincloth soaked in blood had been found; also a staff. These '''properties''' were known to have belonged to a toddy drawer. He had disappeared.}} # {{senseid|en|real property}} A piece of [[real estate]], such as a parcel of land. #: {{syn|en|land|parcel}} #: {{ux|en|There is a large house on the '''property'''.}} #: {{ux|en| He owns over ten '''properties''' in the country.}} # {{lb|en|British}} [[real estate|Real estate]]; the business of selling [[house]]s. #: {{ux|en|He works in '''property''' as a housing consultant.}} # The [[exclusive]] [[right]] of [[possess]]ing, [[enjoy]]ing and disposing of a [[thing]]. # {{senseid|en|object attribute}}An [[attribute]] or [[abstract]] [[quality]] associated with an individual, object or concept. #: {{ux|en|Charm is his most endearing '''property'''.}} #* {{quote-journal|en|year=2013|month=July-August|author=[http://www.americanscientist.org/authors/detail/philip-j-bushnell Philip J. Bushnell] |magazine=w:American Scientist|title=[http://www.americanscientist.org/issues/feature/2013/4/solvents-ethanol-car-crashes-amp-tolerance Solvents, Ethanol, Car Crashes & Tolerance] |passage=Furthermore, this increase in risk is comparable to the risk of death from leukemia after long-term exposure to benzene, another solvent, which has the well-known '''property''' of causing this type of cancer.}} # {{senseid|en|class attribute}}An [[attribute]] or [[abstract]] [[quality]] which is characteristic of a class of objects. #: {{ux|en|Matter can have many '''properties''', including color, mass and density.}} #* {{quote-journal|en|year=2013|month=July-August|author=[http://www.americanscientist.org/authors/detail/lee-s-langston Lee S. The name comes from the Latin ''turbo'', meaning ''vortex'', and thus the defining '''property''' of a turbine is that a fluid or gas turns the blades of a rotor, which is attached to a shaft that can perform useful work.}} # {{lb|en|computing}} An [[editable]] or [[read-only]] [[parameter]] associated with an [[application]], component or [[class]]; especially {{lb|en|OOP}} one that [[encapsulate]]s an underlying [[variable]]. #: {{ux|en|You need to set the debugging '''property''' to "verbose".}} # {{lb|en|usually|in the plural|theater}} A [[prop]], an object used in a
